label: PF Backlog 71
title: Backend: project soft-delete -> 7-day archive -> retrievable -> hard delete with pre-delete reminder
body: Owner (P53): when a user deletes a project, do NOT hard-delete immediately. Archive (soft-delete) the project's data for 7 DAYS so it can be restored/retrieved; then permanently delete it. Send a warning reminder to the user 1-2 days BEFORE permanent deletion (and at delete time), with a restore option. Respect the safety contract: only the project's own data is removed, via its owner (no recursive deletion of shared state under products/). Configurable retention (default 7 days).
